title: Cross-room carry Stage A: west pickup room -> divider door -> zone B arrival (unloaded solo)
policy_source_commit_note: visgoal candidate C build (PR #582 draft). Vendored byte copy in experiments/2026-10-18-crossroom-carry/vendor/visual_goal_search.py; the runner registers it as sim.visual_goal_search before use.

scene.stage_a_scene: s1_normal_mixed_v7 full scene (cargo boxes and long_beam included)
scene.host_note: same L4 host as the visgoal gate r4/B/C runs. Results are not pooled with those runs (different starts, cap and stage).

start_groups.N: near-wall starts (new; setup-validated before the gate)
start_groups.F: far-side pickup-room starts reusing the visgoal west e00-e07 coordinates

cap_end_note: cap_end is a separate termination label, never a rejection reason. The 180 Sim s cap is a new condition and is not pooled with the visgoal 120 Sim s runs.
eval_only: separate cells only; the controller never receives gt_*, world pose, spawn pose, static map, top camera or zone/door coordinates

input_audit.implementation: controller_boundary_v1: every skill.control/memory_observation/memory.step argument dict is scanned at the boundary and forbidden-key attempts are counted; a detected key fails the episode as input_audit_fail. Counters are not runner-written constants.

search_policy_note: Stage A reuses the visgoal C search policy (expanding lawnmower schedule 20/344/60/300/60 ticks and the 0.142 m arrival aim inset) with the cap raised to 180 Sim s. Candidate C's own 120 Sim s gate result is a separate condition and is not pooled with this run; its recount is used only as the prior funnel and as the basis for keeping/changing the search schedule before this prereg is frozen.
mission_scope: Stage A measures the unloaded destination search after crossing the divider door. No cargo is grasped, carried or released, so the mission-level carry across the wall (Stage B/B+) is not verified by this stage. The full mission also needs ACT grasp/release; those are separate component gates.
setup_validation: scripts/crossroom_setup_check.py runs on gcp3 before the gate: sim spawn-overlap admission per start plus explicit distances to the long_beam/cargo bodies and peer park clearance. Its setup-validation.json is committed before the gate. If a start is invalid it is replaced and this prereg is updated before any gate result is seen.
expected_wall: 16 worlds x 180 Sim s at the gcp3 batch rate (2.75-3.2 wall/(sim_s*nworld)) is about 2.5-3.1 h for the gate; a 2-start 60 s preflight runs first.
